artifact.title: Geofenced Time‑Punch Validation Microservice Function
artifact.description: Provide a Python microservice function `validate_punch(employee_id: int, timestamp: datetime, lat: float, lng: float) -> ValidationResult` that verifies the punch is within 100 m of the office location (12.9716, 77.5946) and between 06:00 and 22:00 local office time. The function returns a JSON object `{ "valid": bool, "reason": str }`. The implementation must use strictly typed Pydantic models for inputs and outputs.
acceptance_criteria: The function returns `valid: true` with reason "Punch accepted" when the supplied coordinates are within 100 m of (12.9716, 77.5946) and the timestamp is between 06:00 and 22:00 office local time.
The function returns `valid: false` with an appropriate reason when the location is outside the 100 m radius.
The function returns `valid: false` with an appropriate reason when the timestamp is outside the allowed window.
